title: ARV spelled out as 'alien reproduction vehicle' in the briefing, seen as counterintelligence marker
summary: Matthew Brown tells of ARV spelled out as 'alien reproduction vehicle' in the briefing, seen as counterintelligence marker, about c. 2018 at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know, to the best of my recollection, it was expanded as alien reproduction vehicle.

plain: Matthew Brown, who describes himself as a whistleblower from inside the Pentagon, says that a briefing he saw, around 2018, on the capabilities of a secret effort he calls Immaculate Constellation spelled out the letters ARV as "alien reproduction vehicle", to the best of his memory. Brown, who also mentions Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a UFO study effort, reads that wording as a possible counterintelligence marker, a detail placed to trace or steer how information spreads.
